class GPUModelRunner:
    def sample(self, hidden_states, input_batch, grammar_output):
        if self.batch_sharder is not None:
            logits = None
        else:
            sample_hidden_states = hidden_states[input_batch.logits_indices]
            logits = self.model.compute_logits(sample_hidden_states)

        if grammar_output is not None:
            self.structured_outputs_worker.apply_grammar_bitmask(logits, input_batch)

        sampler_output: SamplerOutput | None
        if input_batch.num_reqs == 0:
            sampler_output = None
        elif input_batch.num_draft_tokens == 0 or self.rejection_sampler is None:
            sampler_output = self.sampler(logits, input_batch)
        return sampler_output

    def execute_model(self, input_batch, dummy_run=False):
        # Run model.
        model_output = self.model(input_batch)

        self.kv_connector.finish_forward()
        return model_output
